description: This is a controller class in an OpenCart project handling product reviews. It manages review display, listing, submission, and associated logic including CAPTCHA validation, pagination, and user authentication.

classes.name: Review
classes.description: Controller class for handling product reviews in OpenCart, including displaying reviews, submitting new reviews, and managing CAPTCHA verification.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Displays the main review page, loads language resources, scripts, review data, and CAPTCHA if enabled.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Outputs the list of reviews for a product, primarily for AJAX or internal calls.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Retrieves and formats a paginated list of reviews for a specific product, returning HTML view.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Handles submission of a new review, including validation, CAPTCHA verification, and saving the review.
